input.rationale: discharge_date is only recorded for inpatient (IPD) stays; outpatient and emergency visits end on the day they start, which is the OHDSI convention when no end date is known.

final_text: The visit_occurrence insert failed because visit_end_date is required but clinic_visits.discharge_date is empty for every OPD and EMERG visit: the counts of visits without a discharge date equal the OPD and EMERG totals, and no IPD visit lacks one (only IPD stays have a discharge date). I changed visit_end_date to COALESCE(v.discharge_date::date, v.visit_date::date), so single-day visits end on their start date. No data-quality results were available yet because the build stopped at this error.
